description: This file defines the EnkryptAIGuardrails class, a custom guardrail implementation for use with large language models (LLMs). It handles API calls to EnkryptAI for content moderation, including request/response analysis, attack detection, and guardrail status determination. It also provides hooks for pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming response processing.

classes.name: EnkryptAIGuardrails
classes.description: A custom guardrail class for integrating EnkryptAI content moderation into LLM workflows, with methods for API communication, response processing, and various guardrail hooks.

methods.name: _call_enkryptai_guardrails
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous API call to EnkryptAI to analyze a prompt for violations.

methods.name: _process_enkryptai_guardrails_response
methods.description: Processes the API response to identify detected attacks and their details.

methods.name: _determine_guardrail_status
methods.description: Determines the overall guardrail status based on API response, indicating success, intervention, or failure.

methods.name: _create_error_message
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message summarizing detected violations.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-LLM call hook that analyzes input messages for violations before sending to the model.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Parallel hook to analyze input messages during the call for violations.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-LLM call hook that analyzes model responses for violations.

methods.name: apply_guardrail
methods.description: Applies guardrail checks to a batch of texts, raising errors if violations are found.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Streams response items while passing them through the guardrail system.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail.
